title: Structural, Thermodynamic, and Dynamic Descriptors for the Differential Mechanism of HIF-2 Activity Modulators.
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文用全原子MD模拟研究HIF-2/ARNT转录因子复合物中配体对DNA结合域动态及HRE结合的影响，聚焦蛋白-DNA互作机制，但核心对象是配体调控而非TF-DNA结合预测，方法可迁移。
abstract: Hypoxia-inducible factors (HIFs) are heterodimeric transcription factors that are critical for cellular adaptation to low oxygen conditions. Both enhancement and inhibition of HIF-2 activity have been shown to have a significant therapeutic relevance. We used all-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to elucidate the molecular mechanism for the differential effects of HIF-2 ligands on its complex with an aryl hydrocarbon receptor nuclear translocator (ARNT). We find that agonists and antagonists differentially alter the binding site conformation, enthalpically strengthening or weakening the heterodimerization, respectively. These local changes were linked to conformational fluctuations of the HIF-2/ARNT complex, adding an entropic component to the effect of ligand binding on the stability. We report a ligand-dependent effect on the DNA-binding bHLH domain's structure and dynamics, impacting the hypoxia response element (HRE) binding. To understand the pathway of allosteric signal propagation, we employed a network-based analysis of residue correlations, revealing a structurally embedded and evolutionarily conserved communication network that mediates long-range signaling between the ligand-binding and DNA-binding domains. Based on these findings, we present a multiscale approach to enable high-throughput virtual screening of ligands for differential modulation of the structure, dynamics, and transcriptional activity of the HIF-2/ARNT complex.
abstract_zh: 缺氧诱导因子（HIFs）是异二聚体转录因子，对细胞适应低氧条件至关重要。HIF-2活性的增强和抑制均已被证明具有显著的治疗相关性。我们使用全原子分子动力学（MD）模拟来阐明HIF-2配体对其与芳烃受体核转位因子（ARNT）复合物产生差异性效应的分子机制。我们发现激动剂和拮抗剂分别差异性改变结合位点构象，从而在焓上增强或削弱异二聚化作用。这些局部变化与HIF-2/ARNT复合物的构象波动相关联，为配体结合对稳定性的影响增加了熵组分。我们报告了配体依赖性效应对DNA结合bHLH结构域结构和动力学的影响，进而影响缺氧反应元件（HRE）的结合。为了理解变构信号传播的途径，我们采用了基于残基相关性的网络分析，揭示了一个结构嵌入且进化保守的通信网络，该网络介导配体结合域与DNA结合域之间的长程信号传导。基于这些发现，我们提出了一种多尺度方法，以实现对配体的高通量虚拟筛选，用于差异性调节HIF-2/ARNT复合物的结构、动力学和转录活性。
